query.description: Full address to convert to coordinates. Include as much detail as possible (street, city, country) for accurate results. Examples: '1600 Pennsylvania Ave, Washington DC', 'Eiffel Tower, Paris, France'

response_detail.description: Response detail level. 'compact' (default): trimmed response with essential fields only, saves tokens. 'full': complete API response with all fields including coordinates, classifications, etc.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-100). Default: 5

language.description: Preferred language for results using IETF language tags. Examples: 'en-US', 'fr-FR', 'de-DE', 'es-ES'

countrySet.description: Limit results to specific countries using ISO codes. Examples: 'US', 'FR,GB', 'CA,US'

view.description: Geopolitical view for disputed territories. Options: 'Unified', 'AR', 'IL', 'IN', 'MA', 'PK', 'RU', 'TR', 'CN'

extendedPostalCodesFor.description: Include extended postal codes for specific index types. Examples: 'PAD', 'PAD,Addr', 'POI'

mapcodes.description: Include mapcode information in the response. Mapcodes represent specific locations within a few meters and are designed to be short, easy to recognize and communicate. Options: Local, International, Alternative. Examples: 'Local' (local mapcode only), 'Local,Alternative' (multiple types). Accepts array of string(s).

timeZone.description: Used to indicate the mode in which the timeZone object should be returned. Values: iana Mode shows the IANA ID which allows the user to determine the current time zone for the POI. Usage examples: timeZone=iana

geometries.description: Include geometries information in the response

addressRanges.description: Include address ranges in the response

radius.description: Search radius in meters when lat/lon provided

topLeft.description: Top-left coordinates of bounding box (format: 'lat,lon'). Must be used with btmRight

btmRight.description: Bottom-right coordinates of bounding box (format: 'lat,lon'). Must be used with topLeft

entityTypeSet.description:
Filter results by geographic entity types. Valid values: PostalCodeArea,
      CountryTertiarySubdivision, CountrySecondarySubdivision, MunicipalitySubdivision,
      MunicipalitySecondarySubdivision, Country, CountrySubdivision, Neighbourhood, Municipality.

query.description: Full address to convert to coordinates. Include as much detail as possible (street, city, country) for accurate results. Examples: '1600 Pennsylvania Ave, Washington DC', 'Eiffel Tower, Paris, France'

response_detail.description: Response detail level. 'compact' (default): trimmed response with essential fields only, saves tokens. 'full': complete API response with all fields including coordinates, classifications, etc.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-100). Default: 5

language.description: Preferred language for results using IETF language tags. Examples: 'en-US', 'fr-FR', 'de-DE', 'es-ES'

countrySet.description: Limit results to specific countries using ISO codes. Examples: 'US', 'FR,GB', 'CA,US'

view.description: Geopolitical view for disputed territories. Options: 'Unified', 'AR', 'IL', 'IN', 'MA', 'PK', 'RU', 'TR', 'CN'

extendedPostalCodesFor.description: Include extended postal codes for specific index types. Examples: 'PAD', 'PAD,Addr', 'POI'

mapcodes.description: Include mapcode information in the response. Mapcodes represent specific locations within a few meters and are designed to be short, easy to recognize and communicate. Options: Local, International, Alternative. Examples: 'Local' (local mapcode only), 'Local,Alternative' (multiple types). Accepts array of string(s).

timeZone.description: Used to indicate the mode in which the timeZone object should be returned. Values: iana Mode shows the IANA ID which allows the user to determine the current time zone for the POI. Usage examples: timeZone=iana

geometries.description: Include geometries information in the response

addressRanges.description: Include address ranges in the response

radius.description: Search radius in meters when lat/lon provided

topLeft.description: Top-left coordinates of bounding box (format: 'lat,lon'). Must be used with btmRight

btmRight.description: Bottom-right coordinates of bounding box (format: 'lat,lon'). Must be used with topLeft

entityTypeSet.description:
Filter results by geographic entity types. Valid values: PostalCodeArea,
      CountryTertiarySubdivision, CountrySecondarySubdivision, MunicipalitySubdivision,
      MunicipalitySecondarySubdivision, Country, CountrySubdivision, Neighbourhood, Municipality.

query.description: Full address to convert to coordinates. Include as much detail as possible (street, city, country) for accurate results. Examples: '1600 Pennsylvania Ave, Washington DC', 'Eiffel Tower, Paris, France'

response_detail.description: Response detail level. 'compact' (default): trimmed response with essential fields only, saves tokens. 'full': complete API response with all fields including coordinates, classifications, etc.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-100). Default: 5

language.description: Preferred language for results using IETF language tags. Examples: 'en-US', 'fr-FR', 'de-DE', 'es-ES'

countrySet.description: Limit results to specific countries using ISO codes. Examples: 'US', 'FR,GB', 'CA,US'

view.description: Geopolitical view for disputed territories. Options: 'Unified', 'AR', 'IL', 'IN', 'MA', 'PK', 'RU', 'TR', 'CN'

extendedPostalCodesFor.description: Include extended postal codes for specific index types. Examples: 'PAD', 'PAD,Addr', 'POI'

mapcodes.description: Include mapcode information in the response. Mapcodes represent specific locations within a few meters and are designed to be short, easy to recognize and communicate. Options: Local, International, Alternative. Examples: 'Local' (local mapcode only), 'Local,Alternative' (multiple types). Accepts array of string(s).

timeZone.description: Used to indicate the mode in which the timeZone object should be returned. Values: iana Mode shows the IANA ID which allows the user to determine the current time zone for the POI. Usage examples: timeZone=iana

geometries.description: Include geometries information in the response

addressRanges.description: Include address ranges in the response

radius.description: Search radius in meters when lat/lon provided

topLeft.description: Top-left coordinates of bounding box (format: 'lat,lon'). Must be used with btmRight

btmRight.description: Bottom-right coordinates of bounding box (format: 'lat,lon'). Must be used with topLeft

entityTypeSet.description:
Filter results by geographic entity types. Valid values: PostalCodeArea,
      CountryTertiarySubdivision, CountrySecondarySubdivision, MunicipalitySubdivision,
      MunicipalitySecondarySubdivision, Country, CountrySubdivision, Neighbourhood, Municipality.
      Note: This parameter is for geographic entities only, not POIs.
      For POI filtering, use categorySet instead

function.name: tomtom-geocode
function.description: Convert street addresses to coordinates (does not support points of interest)

query.description: Full address to convert to coordinates. Include as much detail as possible (street, city, country) for accurate results. Examples: '1600 Pennsylvania Ave, Washington DC', 'Eiffel Tower, Paris, France'

response_detail.description: Response detail level. 'compact' (default): trimmed response with essential fields only, saves tokens. 'full': complete API response with all fields including coordinates, classifications, etc.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-100). Default: 5

language.description: Preferred language for results using IETF language tags. Examples: 'en-US', 'fr-FR', 'de-DE', 'es-ES'

countrySet.description: Limit results to specific countries using ISO codes. Examples: 'US', 'FR,GB', 'CA,US'

view.description: Geopolitical view for disputed territories. Options: 'Unified', 'AR', 'IL', 'IN', 'MA', 'PK', 'RU', 'TR', 'CN'

extendedPostalCodesFor.description: Include extended postal codes for specific index types. Examples: 'PAD', 'PAD,Addr', 'POI'

mapcodes.description: Include mapcode information in the response. Mapcodes represent specific locations within a few meters and are designed to be short, easy to recognize and communicate. Options: Local, International, Alternative. Examples: 'Local' (local mapcode only), 'Local,Alternative' (multiple types). Accepts array of string(s).

timeZone.description: Used to indicate the mode in which the timeZone object should be returned. Values: iana Mode shows the IANA ID which allows the user to determine the current time zone for the POI. Usage examples: timeZone=iana

geometries.description: Include geometries information in the response

addressRanges.description: Include address ranges in the response

radius.description: Search radius in meters when lat/lon provided

topLeft.description: Top-left coordinates of bounding box (format: 'lat,lon'). Must be used with btmRight

btmRight.description: Bottom-right coordinates of bounding box (format: 'lat,lon'). Must be used with topLeft

entityTypeSet.description:
Filter results by geographic entity types. Valid values: PostalCodeArea,
      CountryTertiarySubdivision, CountrySecondarySubdivision, MunicipalitySubdivision,
      MunicipalitySecondarySubdivision, Country, CountrySubdivision, Neighbourhood, Municipality.
      Note: This parameter is for geographic entities only, not POIs.
      For POI filtering, use categorySet instead

query.description: Full address to convert to coordinates. Include as much detail as possible (street, city, country) for accurate results. Examples: '1600 Pennsylvania Ave, Washington DC', 'Eiffel Tower, Paris, France'

response_detail.description: Response detail level. 'compact' (default): trimmed response with essential fields only, saves tokens. 'full': complete API response with all fields including coordinates, classifications, etc.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-100). Default: 5

language.description: Preferred language for results using IETF language tags. Examples: 'en-US', 'fr-FR', 'de-DE', 'es-ES'

countrySet.description: Limit results to specific countries using ISO codes. Examples: 'US', 'FR,GB', 'CA,US'

view.description: Geopolitical view for disputed territories. Options: 'Unified', 'AR', 'IL', 'IN', 'MA', 'PK', 'RU', 'TR', 'CN'

extendedPostalCodesFor.description: Include extended postal codes for specific index types. Examples: 'PAD', 'PAD,Addr', 'POI'

mapcodes.description: Include mapcode information in the response. Mapcodes represent specific locations within a few meters and are designed to be short, easy to recognize and communicate. Options: Local, International, Alternative. Examples: 'Local' (local mapcode only), 'Local,Alternative' (multiple types). Accepts array of string(s).

timeZone.description: Used to indicate the mode in which the timeZone object should be returned. Values: iana Mode shows the IANA ID which allows the user to determine the current time zone for the POI. Usage examples: timeZone=iana

geometries.description: Include geometries information in the response

addressRanges.description: Include address ranges in the response

radius.description: Search radius in meters when lat/lon provided

topLeft.description: Top-left coordinates of bounding box (format: 'lat,lon'). Must be used with btmRight

btmRight.description: Bottom-right coordinates of bounding box (format: 'lat,lon'). Must be used with topLeft

entityTypeSet.description:
Filter results by geographic entity types. Valid values: PostalCodeArea,
      CountryTertiarySubdivision, CountrySecondarySubdivision, MunicipalitySubdivision,
      MunicipalitySecondarySubdivision, Country, CountrySubdivision, Neighbourhood, Municipality.
      Note: This parameter is for geographic entities only, not POIs.
      For POI filtering, use categorySet instead

function.name: tomtom-geocode
function.description: Convert street addresses to coordinates (does not support points of interest)

query.description: Full address to convert to coordinates. Include as much detail as possible (street, city, country) for accurate results. Examples: '1600 Pennsylvania Ave, Washington DC', 'Eiffel Tower, Paris, France'

response_detail.description: Response detail level. 'compact' (default): trimmed response with essential fields only, saves tokens. 'full': complete API response with all fields including coordinates, classifications, etc.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-100). Default: 5

language.description: Preferred language for results using IETF language tags. Examples: 'en-US', 'fr-FR', 'de-DE', 'es-ES'

countrySet.description: Limit results to specific countries using ISO codes. Examples: 'US', 'FR,GB', 'CA,US'

view.description: Geopolitical view for disputed territories. Options: 'Unified', 'AR', 'IL', 'IN', 'MA', 'PK', 'RU', 'TR', 'CN'

extendedPostalCodesFor.description: Include extended postal codes for specific index types. Examples: 'PAD', 'PAD,Addr', 'POI'

mapcodes.description: Include mapcode information in the response. Mapcodes represent specific locations within a few meters and are designed to be short, easy to recognize and communicate. Options: Local, International, Alternative. Examples: 'Local' (local mapcode only), 'Local,Alternative' (multiple types). Accepts array of string(s).

timeZone.description: Used to indicate the mode in which the timeZone object should be returned. Values: iana Mode shows the IANA ID which allows the user to determine the current time zone for the POI. Usage examples: timeZone=iana

geometries.description: Include geometries information in the response

addressRanges.description: Include address ranges in the response

radius.description: Search radius in meters when lat/lon provided

topLeft.description: Top-left coordinates of bounding box (format: 'lat,lon'). Must be used with btmRight

btmRight.description: Bottom-right coordinates of bounding box (format: 'lat,lon'). Must be used with topLeft

entityTypeSet.description:
Filter results by geographic entity types. Valid values: PostalCodeArea,
      CountryTertiarySubdivision, CountrySecondarySubdivision, MunicipalitySubdivision,
      MunicipalitySecondarySubdivision, Country, CountrySubdivision, Neighbourhood, Municipality.
      Note: This parameter is for geographic entities only, not POIs.
      For POI filtering, use categorySet instead
